gui.universalarmor.part.frame.tip: The body of the armor. Sets most of its durability and its main colour. Required.
gui.universalarmor.part.padding.tip: The lining. Adds a little defense and toughness, shown on the inner shading.
gui.universalarmor.part.plating.tip: The outer plates. Provides most of the defense and toughness.
gui.universalarmor.part.attachment.tip: Straps, buckles and trim. A small boost to durability and defense.
gui.universalarmor.part.optional: Optional: if left empty, an earlier slot's material is reused.
gui.universalarmor.preview.empty: Place a Frame material to preview
gui.universalarmor.stats.title: Full set
gui.universalarmor.spin.tip: Toggle automatic rotation. Drag the preview to turn it.
guide.universalarmor.welcome.1: The Armory Station builds armor from any items, vanilla or modded. Pick four materials, choose a shape, and the preview shows exactly what you will get.
guide.universalarmor.welcome.2: Craft the station from iron ingots, stone and a crafting table. Place a material in each of its four slots, then take the pieces you want from the right.
guide.universalarmor.welcome.3: The armor's colours come from the items' own textures, so wood looks like wood and netherite looks like netherite.
guide.universalarmor.parts.1: Each slot is colour-keyed to its label on the station. Hover an empty slot for details.
guide.universalarmor.parts.2: Frame: the body of the armor. Sets most of its durability. Required.
guide.universalarmor.parts.3: Padding: the lining. Adds a little defense and toughness.
guide.universalarmor.parts.4: Plating: the outer plates. Gives most of the defense and toughness.
guide.universalarmor.parts.5: Attachment: straps and trim. A small boost to durability and defense.
guide.universalarmor.shapes.1: Use the arrows under the preview to pick a shape. Each one trades protection against weight.
guide.universalarmor.shapes.3: Heavy: 50% more defense, 20% more durability and double toughness, but a full set is 12% slower.
guide.universalarmor.shapes.4: Light: 30% less defense, 20% less durability and no toughness, but a full set is 12% faster.
guide.universalarmor.costs.1: Each piece needs several of every part:
guide.universalarmor.costs.6: Hover any output slot to see its cost and which materials you are missing.
guide.universalarmor.tips.1: Only the Frame is required. An empty Padding or Plating reuses the Frame, and an empty Attachment reuses the Padding.
guide.universalarmor.tips.2: Drag the preview to turn the armor, or switch off the automatic Spin.
guide.universalarmor.tips.3: Strong materials such as netherite, diamond and steel raise every stat. Soft ones like wood or gold are cheap but weak.
guide.universalarmor.tips.4: Stats are fixed when the armor is crafted.
guide.universalarmor.tips.5: Repair armor with its Plating or Frame material.
